
 Usage: root skill [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 Install the packaged MDF agent skills (Claude, Codex, Gemini)

   Options
  --help          Show this message and exit.

   Commands
  install  Install a packaged MDF skill into your coding agent.
  path     Print the location of a packaged skill bundle.
  list     List the skill bundles shipped with mdf-cli.
